title: nan
authors: Belfadel D.; Haessig D.; Chibane C.
key_contribution: Presents a relative navigation system for UAV swarms in GPS-denied environments using an EKF fusing IMU and ranging measurements, demonstrated with a six-drone simulation in a challenging scenario.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
